name: Yamase Chihaya
source:
Likes: Her iguana plushie
Dislikes: Spicy foods and P.E. classes
Hobbies: Shopping and reading

A girl from Class 1-4, and one of [url=/c11268]Nana[/url]'s friends that end up with her in Heavenly Host. She is a side character in Extra Chapter 1 in Corpse Party: Blood Covered. Chihaya is a cute but quiet junior high school student, who breaks down and cries easily. In Corpse Party: 2U, she seems to have a small crush on [url=/c6501]Yoshiki[/url], since after seeing him she thinks that he's "kind of cool" and blushing every time she's close to him.

[From [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Chihaya_Yamase]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
